capabilities: Delete sections, heading blocks, fenced code blocks, callouts, or blockquotes at the cursor
Copy, cut, and move sections among their siblings
Navigate to parent, sibling, and child section headings
Promote or demote a section's heading levels
Extract the current section into a new note, optionally linked from the source
disambiguation: Not an outlining or table-of-contents tool; it runs structural commands on sections rather than displaying an outline.
extras: Extraction safety is documented in detail: it updates relative links and embeds inside the moved section, cancels if paths or footnote references cannot be resolved, and undo behavior for deletions and extractions is specified. Commands have no default hotkeys.
problem: Acting on a whole heading-and-content section in Obsidian requires manually selecting exact lines; the editor offers no section-aware commands.
summary: Command set for acting on Markdown sections at the cursor: delete, copy, move, navigate, promote/demote, and extract them to other notes.
